critical_code_review_comments: FIXED during this run: server.py _export_inspector was inserting the inspector report into db.inspector_reports WITHOUT engine_metadata and safety_envelope, while /profiles/{id}/inspector/audit did include them. The refactor regressed this contract. Added the two fields to the saved dict so deep-linked inspector reports from /export/inspector now match those from /inspector/audit (required for ExplainFinding to send engine context).

ExplainFinding.jsx: data-testid pattern 'explain-{CODE}' is also used as a prefix for the output container testid 'explain-{CODE}-output' — a CSS '[data-testid^="explain-"]' selector matches BOTH. Non-blocking, but tests should use exact matches or differentiate prefixes (e.g. 'explain-out-{CODE}').

server.py explain_finding: uses lazy import inside the handler (fine), and properly escapes \n for SSE. Consider also flushing/yielding a heartbeat every N tokens for proxies that buffer; current 'X-Accel-Buffering: no' header is correctly set.
ExportPanel.jsx is at 209 lines and reasonable; no need to split.

rca of the issue: Bug: _export_inspector helper omitted engine_metadata and safety_envelope when persisting the inspector_reports document, although /profiles/{id}/inspector/audit included them. Cause: when extracting the per-target helpers during the refactor, only the report body (**report) was spread into the saved dict — the two enrichment fields were lost. Fix: re-added both keys (intake + package['safety_envelope']) to the saved dict in _export_inspector. Verified with test_export_inspector_refactored. Impact pre-fix: ExplainFinding called from a deep-linked inspector report would not have engine context. Post-fix: contract matches /inspector/audit.
